program: MYH6 vs MYH7 myosin heavy-chain isoform ratio
in_vitro_finding: hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes express a fetal-like isoform profile with relatively high MYH6; MYH7 rises with extended culture / maturation protocols but rarely reaches adult ratio.
in_vivo_finding: Adult human ventricle is MYH7-dominant (MYH6 low). (Mouse is the opposite — adult mouse ventricle is Myh6-dominant — so the mouse axis is a divergence, see verdict_note.)
patient_finding: Adult patient ventricular tissue MYH7-dominant; MYH6:MYH7 shift is itself a heart-failure readout.
